scripts.dev: npm -w @logicrush/shared run build && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm -w @logicrush/shared run dev" "npm -w @logicrush/server run dev" "npm -w @logicrush/web run dev"
scripts.dev:e2e: npm -w @logicrush/shared run build && npm -w @logicrush/server run build && concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm -w @logicrush/server run start" "npm -w @logicrush/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w @logicrush/shared run build && npm -w @logicrush/server run build && npm -w @logicrush/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @logicrush/shared run build && npm -w @logicrush/server run typecheck && npm -w @logicrush/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run lint:deps && npm run check:structure && npm -w @logicrush/shared run build && npm -w @logicrush/server test && npm -w @logicrush/web test
scripts.test:e2e:seed: npm -w @logicrush/server run db:migrate && npm -w @logicrush/server run db:seed
